post.description:
Put the library version of components in place of the project's copies: their parts
keep place, reference and values, the old sheets go (one undo step).

A template as sheets of the project to edit (template editor): a user template's own
sheets (changed in place, or with ``as_new`` a new template based on it), a built-in one drawn
from its formulas or a part's circuit (always a new template). ``form`` values replace the
defaults. One undo step; the top sheet carries the template's form.

Put a block's circuit in its place (one undo step): its parts, wires and labels copied
beside where it was, its ports turned into labels that join the nets on the block's pins,
its parameters written into the values. The sheet stays (other blocks may use it).

AddObjects.title: AddObjects
AddObjects.description: Add objects; instance refs ending in ``?`` are numbered automatically.

AttachComponent.title: AttachComponent
AttachComponent.description: Undo of ``detach_component``: the sheets belong to the component again.

Batch.title: Batch
Batch.description:
Points streamed by an instrument: appended to a characteristic of a measurement (both
made when new).

target.title: Target
target.description: schematic | sheet:<name> | selection | refs:R1,C2 | window | plot (headless: plot:<run_id>:V(out),V(in)) | graph

Characteristic.title: Characteristic
Characteristic.description: Source points of a characteristic (datasheet, measurement): |Z|(f), C(V), I-V...

Component.title: Component
Component.description: A real part in a library: its equivalent circuit is ``sheets`` (the first is the top).

symbol.title: Symbol
symbol.description: Symbol id, e.g. resistor, capacitor, npn, vsource

nets.title: Nets
nets.description: Net per pin in SPICE order; '0' is ground

ComponentData.title: ComponentData
ComponentData.description: A component's data edited without its circuit (D15: description, category, metadata).

ComponentInfo.title: ComponentInfo
ComponentInfo.description: What makes a block a real part (D15, FR-CMP): kind, metadata, ratings, versions.

DcAnalysis.title: DcAnalysis
DcAnalysis.description:
DC sweep of a source (``source`` is its ref, e.g. ``V1``), a resistor (``R1``) or the
temperature (``TEMP``); with ``source2`` the sweep repeats for each of its values (a family
of curves, e.g. Ic(Vce) for several base currents).

DetachComponent.title: DetachComponent
DetachComponent.description: Make a placed component's sheets ordinary, editable block sheets ("Make a copy").

Directive.title: Directive
Directive.description: Free SPICE text placed on the schematic (``.param``, ``.include``, ...).

DynamicOutputs.title: DynamicOutputs
DynamicOutputs.description:
Outputs made from a parameter: one per item of a "choices" parameter (comma-separated),
named by the item, after the first ``skip`` items (those have static outputs).

Graph.title: Graph
Graph.description: Analysis graph (see node.md): simulations, calculations and views as connected nodes.

GraphEdge.title: GraphEdge
GraphEdge.description: Output ``output`` of node ``source`` feeds input ``input`` of node ``target``.

GraphGroup.title: GraphGroup
GraphGroup.description: A frame around nodes with a title (the nodes inside it move with it on the canvas).

GraphNode.title: GraphNode
GraphNode.description:
A node of an analysis graph: its type (``sim/tran``), widget values and placement.

``version``: of its type's parameters when it was made (older ones are migrated by the
catalogue); ``title``: the user's name for it ("" = the type's); ``bypass``: switched off,
its input passed on to an output of the same type, else its branch skipped;
``param_inputs``: parameters turned into ``scalar`` input sockets of the same name (a number
from another node sets them).

GraphReroute.title: GraphReroute
GraphReroute.description:
A point an edge passes through (to route it): what comes in (input ``in``) goes out
(output ``out``) unchanged.

has_title.title: Has Title
has_title.description: First line is a title (SPICE files)

Label.title: Label
Label.description: Net label; ``local`` labels join nets within a sheet, ``global`` across sheets.

Look-Input.title: Look
Look-Input.description: Another drawing of the same part (ANSI zigzag, electrolytic capacitor...); same pins.

Look-Output.title: Look
Look-Output.description: Another drawing of the same part (ANSI zigzag, electrolytic capacitor...); same pins.

ModelRef.title: ModelRef
ModelRef.description:
What simulates an instance.

``builtin``: the symbol's default SPICE element, configured by ``params``
(e.g. ``{"R": "10k"}`` or ``{"dc": "5", "tran": "SIN(0 1 1k)"}``).
``model`` optionally names a model card (``.model``) from the project or a library.

NodeTypeInfo.title: NodeTypeInfo
NodeTypeInfo.description: What the editor needs to draw a node and its widgets.

Parasitic.title: Parasitic
Parasitic.description:
A non-ideal property of a part: an extra R, L or C in series or in parallel with it.

Stored like any parameter (``key`` in the instance params); empty = absent (ideal).
The netlister expands it into a separate element.

Pin.title: Pin
Pin.description: ``at`` is the connection point relative to the symbol origin (unrotated).

RestoreProject.title: RestoreProject
RestoreProject.description: Replace the whole content of the project (going back to a snapshot); keeps its id.

RunFamily.title: RunFamily
RunFamily.description:
A run holding several curves one after another (DC sweep with a second source): each
signal is ``len(values)`` blocks of ``length`` points, block k at ``name = values[k]``.

SetDefaultLook.title: SetDefaultLook
SetDefaultLook.description: The drawing new parts of ``symbol`` get in this project (None: as the settings ask).

SetGraph.title: SetGraph
SetGraph.description: Create, replace (``graph``) or delete (``graph=None``) the analysis graph ``name``.

SetModel.title: SetModel
SetModel.description: Set (or delete with None) a project model card.

SetParameter.title: SetParameter
SetParameter.description: Set (or delete with None) a project-wide ``.param``, or a block parameter of ``sheet``.

SetParams.title: SetParams
SetParams.description:
Set (string) or delete (None) instance parameters.

``model`` (model name), ``pins`` (pin map of a subcircuit model) and ``variant`` change only
when given explicitly (``None`` clears them).

SetPortLayout.title: SetPortLayout
SetPortLayout.description: Side and order of the pins of a sheet's block symbol.

SetProjectLook.title: SetProjectLook
SetProjectLook.description: Keep (or with None drop) a copy of a user drawing for ``symbol`` in the project.

SetSheetForm.title: SetSheetForm
SetSheetForm.description: The form of a sheet drawn as a template: labels, units, defaults of its parameters.

SetSheetSymbol.title: SetSheetSymbol
SetSheetSymbol.description: Draw the block symbol of a sheet (pin numbers = port names) or (None) go automatic.

SetSimulation.title: SetSimulation
SetSimulation.description: Replace the simulation settings (active analysis and its parameters).

SetSubcircuit.title: SetSubcircuit
SetSubcircuit.description: Add, replace or (with None) remove a subcircuit model of the project.

SetSymbol.title: SetSymbol
SetSymbol.description: Add, replace or (with None) remove the project's copy of a library symbol.

SetSymbolLink.title: SetSymbolLink
SetSymbolLink.description: Use a library symbol by reference (follows the library) or as a plain copy.

SetSymbolStandard.title: SetSymbolStandard
SetSymbolStandard.description:
IEC or ANSI drawings for this project's parts without a look of their own (None: as the
program's setting).

SheetVariant.title: SheetVariant
SheetVariant.description:
Another model of a block (FR-CMP-8, FR-HIE-3): a sheet with the same ports simulated
instead when a block chooses it ("Simulate as"), e.g. an averaged model of a converter.

Simulation.title: Simulation
Simulation.description:
Last parameters of each analysis kind (SPICE cards) and which one runs; the circuit
temperature and simulator options apply to every analysis started from Simulate.

SpiceMapping.title: SpiceMapping
SpiceMapping.description:
How an instance becomes a SPICE element line.

``nodes`` lists pin numbers in SPICE node order; ``"=0"`` stands for the ground node
(used e.g. by the ideal op-amp, a VCVS referenced to ground).

StressRules.title: StressRules
StressRules.description: Stress analysis margins (FR-SIM-7): the part of each rating a design may use.

SubcktModel.title: SubcktModel
SubcktModel.description:
A device model written as a subcircuit (``.subckt name pins params: ... .ends``).

``body`` holds the ngspice lines between the header and ``.ends``; ``original`` the text
as found in the manufacturer's file. Parts use it as an ``X`` element.

Subgraph.title: Subgraph
Subgraph.description: A graph used as one node (G4): its sockets and parameters at its boundary.

Template.title: Template
Template.description: The standard equivalent circuit the sheets were generated from, with its form values.

TemplateField.title: TemplateField
TemplateField.description: A form field of a user template: one parameter of its top sheet.

TextPlace.title: TextPlace
TextPlace.description:
Where a part's text (reference, value) was put by hand: offset from the part's origin in
sheet axes and its rotation (90 = read bottom to top).

TranAnalysis.title: TranAnalysis
TranAnalysis.description: Transient analysis; ``tmax`` limits the internal time step.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Several commands applied atomically as one undo step.

UpdateInstance.title: UpdateInstance
UpdateInstance.description:
Set any of ``ref``, ``symbol``, ``at``, ``rot``, ``mirror``, ``look`` ("" = automatic),
``ratings`` and ``texts`` (each replaced as a whole; ``texts`` {} = where the symbol puts
them).

UserTemplate.title: UserTemplate
UserTemplate.description:
An equivalent circuit to make components from (FR-CMP-9): a form over sheet parameters.

The first sheet is the top: its ports are the part's pins, its parameters the fields.

Variant.title: Variant
Variant.description: Another way to simulate the same part (ideal / behavioural / transistor level...).

VariantAdd.title: VariantAdd
VariantAdd.description: Another model of a library part (FR-CMP-8): a project sheet with the same ports.

VersionNote.title: VersionNote
VersionNote.description: An earlier version of a library part or template: when and what changed in it.
